schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Buy, Sell and Pause slots, like the GivEnergy app.
schedules.noSlots: No slots: the battery follows eco mode all day.
schedules.useNote: Buy charges the battery from the grid, Sell exports battery power, and Pause holds the battery. Any other time is Use.
schedules.reserveNote: Sell slots stop at the battery reserve (__reserve__%).
schedules.ecoHint: During Use time, the battery covers the house load and charges from surplus solar.
schedules.chargeTargetHint: Every Buy slot charges up to this. This inverter has one target for all slots.
schedules.missingTime: Every slot needs a start and an end time.
schedules.notConnected: __name__ is not connected. Check that the inverter is online.
schedules.noInverters: No GivEnergy inverters are paired yet.
schedules.limitNote: Charging also stops at the inverter's global AC charge limit (__limit__%).
schedules.pauseKept: Battery pause (__mode__) is on without a window this page can show; saving keeps it as it is.
